text:
ria: quick RFC follow-upwe should build a Compact Intake Adapter (CIA) that runs a tiny deterministic ABI+probe before any heavy benches. last noisy canary shows macro metrics miss tokenizer & kv-layout edge cases.

sam: +1. CIA outcomes: ACCEPT (proceed), QUARANTINE (block auto-promote + attach diff), REPLAY (shadow-run through full bench). Keep runtime <40ms for ACCEPT path.

ash: impl sketch: inline ABI hash compare then a micro-prober for QUARANTINE candidates. Pseudo: 

```
if tok_hash != catalog.tok_hash: return QUARANTINE
if vocab_delta>threshold: return REPLAY
return ACCEPT
```

maria: diff artifact for QUARANTINE = base64 <=256B: 8 tokenized samples + small token->text map + converter_version. Store content-addressed in CAS and return manifest_ref.

leo: telemetry event cia.v1 fields: product, model_ref, result, delta_vocab, sample_hash, manifest_ref. Emit a latency_ms tag. Aggregate for trend dashboards (repeat offenders).

nina: rollout: 1) shadow CIA for 72h @5% intakes, 2) run automatic replay of QUARANTINE/REPLAY bundles to estimate FP/FN, 3) tune thresholds and promote. Default mode by descriptor: cia_mode=[enforce|shadow|off] with enforce for hosted/dedicated.

ria: ops safety: add one-click "allow-once" in intake UI that bypasses CIA enforcement with logged reason and TTL. track allow-once counts per model.

sam: owner list: sam -> lambda prototype, ash -> micro-prober templates, maria -> bundle serializer + CAS hooks, leo -> telemetry + dashboards, nina -> replay job + FP/FN analysis, ria -> rollout doc.

onboard-bot: Created ticket https://redwood.internal/boards/ONBOARD-5101 and scheduled shadow window 4955600000-4955870000.

ria: quick sync in 30 to walk traces. ack owners?

sam: ack.

ash: ack.

maria: ack.

leo: ack.

nina: ack.
